Name: Magnolia
Review:
This movie was over 3 hours long and I truly wish it was so much longer. 

I wanted to stay in this world with these characters even though this was one of the loneliest and depressing movies I've ever seen. I cannot remember another movie making me feel the range of emotions I just did. I cannot believe that this many storylines worked and I cared about all of them for over 3 hours. 

Not to mention almost everyone in this movie gave one of their career best performances (I'm sure there are movies I haven't seen where maybe they're better but Cruise and Moore especially were unbelievably great). I also love how surprisingly perfect John C Reilly is for each role he's in when working with PTA.

Almost every scene Donnie is in is gutting. "I have so much love to give but don't know where to put it" comes when you thought the depression was over

This is a must watch what a movie

EDIT: the entire movie I kept thinking to myself John C Reilly as a cop looks exactly like the cop in weapons and did some reading and turns out he was modeled after John C Reilly's character in Magnolia mustache and all that's so cool
